## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) 是 MiniMax 推出的通用全模态生成模型。它能够联合理解文本、图像、视频和音频，并生成带有**原生立体声音频**的视频：语音、音效和音乐在单次前向传播中联合建模，而非后期叠加合成。输出规格支持最高 2K 分辨率、24fps 帧率以及约 15 秒的时长。

## 关于此工作流

该模板执行**图生视频**（Image to Video）任务（对应 `MiniMaxH3ImageToVideo` 节点），涵盖以下两种模式：

- **t2va**（文生视频）：未连接图像输入时
- **fl2va**（首/末帧图生视频）：连接了 `first_frame`（首帧）和/或 `last_frame`（末帧）时

**关键输入**

- **first_frame / last_frame**：可选的关键帧；模型将生成这两帧之间的动态变化
- **prompt**（提示词）：在一个文本块中描述镜头画面、动态效果及配套音频（对话、音效、音乐）
- **width / height**（宽/高）：通过分辨率选择器设置。H3 的原生画布短边为 768px，最大分辨率限制为 768x1344 像素，数值会自动取整为 32 的倍数
- **duration (seconds)**（时长/秒）：由数学表达式节点转换为有效的帧数 `length`，并按 24fps 向上对齐至模型“每块 17 帧”（即 17k+5）的网格标准

Bold comic-book ink style, heavy linework, red and blue-black palette, night city. Use <Picture 2> and <Picture 1> as reference frames and <Audio 1> exactly as it is.
CUT 1: top-down view of the little boy superhero on the rooftop — red cape fluttering in the wind, hands planted on his hips, freckles and a cocky grin as he looks straight up into the camera. The camera slowly descends toward him as he delivers his line — as he speaks, comic-book graphic overlay text word by word in sync with his voice: "GET READY TO" - "MEET" — "YOUR" — "MAKER" — huge jagged comic lettering, white with heavy black outlines and red drop shadows, tilted at scrappy angles, until the three words hang stacked in the air above him between his face and the lens.
TRANSITION: a violent WHIP PAN off the rooftop that SMEARS the floating words away with it, motion-streaked —
CUT 2: low hero angle on the colossal black mech-kaiju towering over the skyline as it rears back and unleashes a GIANT terrifying ROAR — jaws wide with fangs, red eyes and chest-core flaring blinding bright, blue lightning arcing off its head, the roar's shockwave rippling dust and rattling windows down the buildings, comic-style speed-lines and ink splatter bursting from the impact of the sound. It leans INTO the camera as the roar peaks. Hold on the roar.

## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## About this workflow

This template runs the **Image to Video** task (`MiniMaxH3ImageToVideo` node), which covers both:

- **t2va** (text-to-video), when no images are connected
- **fl2va** (first/last-frame image-to-video), when `first_frame` and/or `last_frame` are connected

**Key inputs**

- **first_frame / last_frame**: optional keyframes; the model generates the motion between them
- **prompt**: describe the shots, motion, and the accompanying audio (dialogue, SFX, music) in one block
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector. H3's native canvas is a 768px short edge, capped at 768x1344 pixels, rounded to a multiple of 32
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node, snapping up to the model's 17-frame-per-block (17k+5) grid at 24fps

支持多模态参考输入：

- 图像：≤ 9 张图像
- 视频：≤ 3 个片段；每个片段时长必须为 2–15 秒；总时长 ≤ 15 秒
- 音频：≤ 3 个片段；音频必须与图像或视频输入一同提供，不能作为唯一输入；每个片段时长必须为 2–15 秒；总时长 ≤ 15 秒
- 混合输入：所有输入类型文件总数最多为 12 个

## Report Issue

Note: Please update ComfyUI first ([guide](https://docs.comfy.org/installation/update_comfyui)) and prepare required models. Desktop/Cloud updates follow stable releases, so some nightly-supported models may not be available yet.

- Cannot run / runtime errors: [ComfyUI/issues](https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI/issues)
- UI / frontend issues: [ComfyUI_frontend/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/issues)

For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] A 15.00-second, 16:9, 24fps, single-take live-action cinematic photorealistic science-fiction war scene. Begin from the exact instant, ground-level medium-wide composition, spatial relationships, materials, lighting, and cold gray low-saturation color palette established by <Picture 1>. <Picture 1> is the sole reference for every character, machine, environmental, compositional, material, weather, and color detail. Preserve the same adult female pilot with rain-soaked white hair, the same mud-stained white technical suit, and the same enormous damaged purple-and-green biomechanical head embedded heavily in the mud. Preserve the mechanical head’s exact silhouette, broken horn, cracks, armor placement, exposed cables, and existing degree of damage without redesigning or completing unseen structure. The head occupies most of the left side of frame; the pilot remains kneeling in muddy water at the lower right with her forehead pressed tightly against its lower jaw and both hands braced against the cold armor. The distant wasteland, scattered wreckage, and low ridges remain softly blurred beneath the same overcast rainy sky. Throughout the entire unbroken shot, the stabilized camera performs an extremely slow Push In with small amplitude at slow speed from ground height toward the pilot; it never arcs, rises, shakes, cuts, or turns the complete mechanical head into a heroic reveal.

From 00:00.000 to 00:03.200, the pilot keeps her forehead against the armor as if waiting for an answer from inside. Her breathing is short and irregular; each inhale abruptly lifts her shoulders before she forcibly suppresses the movement. Her right palm presses into the lower-jaw seam, her five fingers gradually tightening and slipping slightly on the rain-slick metal. Her left hand moves slowly along an existing crack, searching through touch for any remaining vibration. Both knees remain deeply sunk in the mud; one boot toe scrapes backward under strain, leaving one short groove. Rainwater continuously runs along her white hair, eyelashes, hand, soaked suit, and fractured purple armor.

From 00:03.200 to 00:06.200, she abruptly stops breathing as if she has detected something almost inaudible. Without standing or turning toward the camera, she lifts her forehead only a few centimeters from the armor and angles her left ear toward the mechanical face near its eye. Her eyes widen with fear and her lips part slightly, but no voice emerges. For less than half a second, a single extremely weak, intermittent dark-orange electrical flicker appears deep inside the mechanical eye and immediately dies. One damaged internal relay audibly attempts to engage, then stops completely. The machine never revives: it does not turn, blink, breathe, activate, or move voluntarily.

From 00:06.200 to 00:09.300, she understands that there will be no response. Her jaw tightens first; her nostrils tremble, and tears merge naturally with the rain. She closes only her right hand into a fist and strikes the mechanical lower jaw exactly once. The heavy but restrained blow is driven credibly from her shoulder and torso; immediately after contact, all strength leaves the fist and it slides down the wet, muddy armor. She does not strike again, throw back her head, or turn toward the camera. Remaining close to the mechanical face, the adult woman with a low, hoarse voice broken by nearly unmanageable breathing (S1) speaks softly, with an involuntary inhale separating each word and the final “please” barely audible: <d>[English] Open your eyes… please.</d>

From 00:09.300 to 00:12.600, hold for 0.40 seconds after her final word. Nothing inside the machine responds. She tries to inhale again, but her chest completes only half the motion and her throat releases one short, suppressed sound of failure. She grips an existing armor edge with both hands and attempts to pull her body closer, as though her body weight could force it awake. Her arms tense briefly, then lose all strength. Her spine folds inward and her forehead drops back against the mechanical lower jaw. Her shoulders begin shaking violently and asymmetrically. One low involuntary sob escapes from her chest but never becomes another spoken line.

From 00:12.600 to 00:15.000, she does not recover or lift her head. Her left hand remains locked around the armor seam while her right hand gradually opens, one finger at a time losing strength, until it rests in the muddy water. The camera stops its push-in several steps away, preserving the scale contrast between her collapsed body and the enormous dead machine. In the distance, the wind moves one loose damaged metal fragment, producing a single hollow scrape. During the final second, only rain, her breathing that still cannot settle, and the conspicuous absence of any internal machine operation remain.

All emotion develops physically from denial, searching for life, brief hope, recognition of death, and total loss of bodily support, expressed through breathing, swallowing, finger pressure, shoulder tremors, eye focus, facial tension, and shifts of weight. Keep both knees in contact with the ground and maintain credible hand-to-armor contact with no clipping, floating, or sliding through surfaces. The soaked white technical suit adheres naturally around her elbows and knees; mud smears progressively according to contact without altering its design. Her rain-plastered hair moves only slightly in the crosswind. The mechanical head remains massively embedded in the mud; only rainwater, loose exposed cables, and extremely slight passive metal settling may move. No resurrection, sustained eye glow, energy discharge, flashback, spirit apparition, additional person, enemy, explosion, weapon, visible text, subtitle, slow motion, rapid edit, camera shake, excessive depth-of-field change, costume deformation, mechanical redesign, weather change, time-of-day change, theatrical screaming, rapid sobbing, repeated striking, or exaggerated performance.

overall_soundscape: Close cold rain taps continuously against fractured ceramic armor, soaked fabric, mud, and shallow puddles beneath a low wasteland wind. Preserve intimate irregular breathing, restrained throat sounds, wet fabric friction, gloves slipping over coarse metal, one brief failed internal-relay engagement, and exactly one heavy but unexaggerated fist impact. The centered dialogue remains close and dry enough to understand while retaining every inhale and hoarse throat texture; near the end, one distant metal fragment produces a single hollow scrape, while the machine remains completely silent.

non_diegetic_music: No music from 00:00.000 through 00:10.000. Beginning only at 00:10.000, introduce one extremely low sustained bowed-string tone that changes very slowly and remains quieter than the rain, with no piano, choir, percussion, trailer impact, heroic melody, or rising emotional swell.
